Season 2: Episode N |seo= }} (Japanese: '''ポケットモンスター ベストウイッシュ シーズン2''' ''Pocket Monsters: Best Wishes! Season 2'') is the second arc of {{aniseries|BW}} that aired on {{wp|TV Tokyo}} from June 21, 2012 to January 10, 2013. It is preceded by the main ''[[List of Pokémon the Series: Black & White episodes#Best Wishes!|Best Wishes! series]]'' arc and followed by ''[[Episode N|Season 2: Episode N]]''. This arc takes {{Ash}}, {{an|Iris}}, and {{an|Cilan}} to East Unova, where they reunite with Sinnoh Champion {{an|Cynthia}} and Ash's former traveling companion {{an|Dawn}}. The mythical Pokémon {{an|Meloetta}} joins their group as they participate in the [[Pokémon World Tournament Junior Cup]] and face [[Team Rocket]]'s largest operation yet. It culminates with the [[Vertress Conference]], Unova's [[Pokémon League]] competition. The arc's opening theme is [[Be an Arrow!]] performed by {{wp|Rica Matsumoto}}, and the ending theme is [[Look Look☆Here]] performed by {{wp|Momoiro Clover Z}}. {{spoilers}} ==Plot== {{Ash}} reunites with Sinnoh Champion {{an|Cynthia}}, who invites the group to travel with her to East Unova. At [[Undella Town]], they discover {{an|Dawn}} staying at Cynthia's villa, leading to a reunion between Ash and his former traveling companion. The mythical Pokémon {{an|Meloetta}} begins following the group and officially joins them on their journey. Cynthia announces the [[Pokémon World Tournament Junior Cup]] in [[Lacunosa Town]], a tournament where the winner earns the right to challenge Unova Champion [[Alder]]. Ash, {{an|Iris}}, {{an|Cilan}}, Dawn, [[Trip]], and other rivals participate in the competition. During this period, Iris {{pkmn2|caught|catches}} a {{TP|Iris|Dragonite}}, though it initially refuses to obey her. The tournament concludes with Trip defeating Ash in the finals, though Trip subsequently loses to Alder. After the tournament, Dawn departs for [[Johto]] to compete in the [[Wallace Cup]]. [[Team Rocket]] launches Operation Tempest, their most ambitious plan yet orchestrated by {{an|Giovanni}} himself. They successfully capture Meloetta and use its song to unseal the [[Reveal Glass]] at the [[Abyssal Ruins]], summoning and controlling the {{an|forces of nature}} in their Therian Formes. Ash and his friends, with unexpected help from the Team Rocket trio, manage to free Meloetta and calm the forces of nature. Following this failure, Giovanni withdraws all Team Rocket operations from Unova and returns to [[Kanto]]. The group visits the [[Village of Dragons]] and [[Opelucid City]], where Iris battles [[Drayden]] and learns he is considering her as his successor for the [[Opelucid Gym]]. They then travel to [[Vertress City]] for the [[Vertress Conference]], where Ash competes using only his current team. Some of the highlights include Ash's {{p|Krokorok}} evolving into {{AP|Krookodile}}, {{un|Cameron}}'s {{p|Riolu}} evolving into {{TP|Cameron|Lucario}} during his battle with Ash, and Ash placing in the Top 8 after losing to Cameron in the quarterfinals. [[Virgil]] ultimately wins the tournament, defeating Cameron in the semifinals and [[Dino]] in the finals. ==Gallery== ===Promotional material=== Best Wishes Season 2 poster.png|Key Visual
